Tax now rounds half-up. `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` had never been written (it just raised `NotImplementedError`), so I implemented it rather than changing existing rounding:

```python
tax = Decimal(amount_cents) * Decimal(str(rate))
return int(tax.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
```

It returns whole cents. I passed the rate through `str()` so a float like `0.0825` doesn't pick up float errors. A quick check gave `tax_for(1000, 0.0825)` → 83; half-even would have given 82. The repo has no tests for this.

The project memory still said tax uses half-even and not to use half-up (a March 2026 decision with finance). I added a new memory recording the switch to half-up and retired the old one; it's kept in history, not deleted. Those memory files live in `.engramdb/` inside the repo, so they'll show in `git status` with the code change. Nothing is committed.
